from pathlib import Path
import copy
import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

work = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ns = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'
ET.register_namespace('', ns)
def tag(name): return '{' + ns + '}' + name
root = ET.parse(work / 'input.groups.svg').getroot()
side = root.find(".//*[@id='shoe--shoe_side']")
shape = side.find(tag('path'))
d = shape.get('d')
start = 'L 251.00,410.50 '
end = 'L 363.50,282.00 '
a = d.index(start) + len(start)
b = d.index(end, a) + len(end)
# This entire seam lies behind shoe_front. Keep the exposed right/bottom edge intact.
shape.set('d', d[:a] + 'C 251.00,393.50 262.50,373.00 278.50,352.50 C 297.00,328.50 317.00,304.00 335.00,285.00 C 342.50,277.00 354.00,273.00 363.50,282.00 ' + d[b:])
ET.SubElement(side, tag('desc')).text = '鞋侧上端被 shoe_front 遮挡；踝部转动及鞋面相对错动时，上方斜接缝可能露出。沿原斜向结构向鞋面内部延伸约 10–20 px，保留右侧、鞋跟及下缘原轮廓。'
front = root.find(".//*[@id='shoe--shoe_front']")
ET.SubElement(front, tag('desc')).text = '鞋前含完整鞋舌、鞋面及鞋头，位于鞋侧前方；已有闭合范围足够，本轮沿用原色块和全部边缘。'

# Follow the existing rear opening's visible contour; close its hidden underside smoothly.
parent_d = root.find(".//*[@id='shoe-silhouette']").get('d')
import re
pts = [(float(x), float(y)) for x, y in re.findall(r'[ML] ([\d.]+),([\d.]+)', parent_d)]
left_start = pts.index((187.0,281.5))
left_end = pts.index((219.5,205.0))
left = [(x+2,y) for x,y in pts[left_start:left_end+1]]
right_start = pts.index((341.5,214.0))
right_end = pts.index((366.0,278.5))
right = [(x-2,y) for x,y in pts[right_start:right_end+1]]
back_d = 'M 189.00,281.50 ' + ' '.join('L %.2f,%.2f' % p for p in left[1:])
back_d += ' C 237.00,198.00 253.00,198.00 270.00,199.50 C 293.00,201.00 320.00,208.00 339.50,214.00 '
back_d += ' '.join('L %.2f,%.2f' % p for p in right[1:])
back_d += ' C 359.00,296.00 340.00,315.00 313.00,323.00 C 287.00,331.00 252.00,329.00 226.00,317.00 C 205.00,307.00 192.00,295.00 189.00,281.50 Z'
back = ET.Element(tag('g'), {'id':'shoe--shoe_back','data-part-path':'shoe/shoe_back'})
ET.SubElement(back, tag('desc')).text = '鞋口后内壁；位于 lower_leg/right_lower_leg、shoe_side 和 shoe_front 后。小腿侧摆或踝部转动后会露出鞋口两侧，故以完整闭合底形跨过小腿遮挡区，向下延伸至 y≈328 接住鞋面；上方沿现有鞋口弧度，父级范围不变。'
ET.SubElement(back, tag('path'), {'id':'shoe--shoe_back-silhouette','d':back_d,'fill':'#78b79a','stroke':'none'})
root.insert(list(root).index(root.find(".//*[@id='lower_leg']")), back)
ET.ElementTree(root).write(work / 'candidate.groups.svg', encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True)
children = {'groups': [], 'parts': [{'name':'shoe_back','note':'shoe 的鞋口后内壁，叠于小腿和鞋前/鞋侧之后；小腿侧摆及踝部转动会露出鞋口两侧，以跨过小腿遮挡区的闭合底形向下承接鞋面并留余量。'}]}
(work / 'children.draft.json').write_text(json.dumps(children, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
print('candidate.groups.svg + children.draft.json')
PY

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:env+" - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import io, sys, json, hashlib, copy
from PIL import Image, ImageChops
sys.path.insert(0,'"+skill+"/tools')
from svg_containment import selected_shape, alpha_image, occupied
from svg_preview import render_svg, validate_svg_resources
w=Path('"+w+"')
old=ET.parse(w/'input.groups.svg').getroot()
new=ET.parse(w/'candidate.groups.svg').getroot()
validate_svg_resources(new)
assert old.attrib==new.attrib
unchanged=['shoe','lower_leg','lower_leg--right_lower_leg']
for identity in unchanged:
 a=old.find(".//*[@id='%s']" % identity)
 b=new.find(".//*[@id='%s']" % identity)
 assert ET.tostring(a)==ET.tostring(b),identity
assert ET.tostring(old.find(".//*[@id='shoe--shoe_front-silhouette']"))==ET.tostring(new.find(".//*[@id='shoe--shoe_front-silhouette']"))

size=(520,690)
def mask(r,path):
 s,_=selected_shape(r,'part',path)
 return occupied(alpha_image(s,size,box=(240,260,140,280),scale=4))
a=mask(old,'shoe/shoe_side'); b=mask(new,'shoe/shoe_side'); f=mask(old,'shoe/shoe_front')
removed=ImageChops.subtract(a,b).histogram()[255]
added=ImageChops.subtract(b,a)
unhidden=ImageChops.subtract(added,f).histogram()[255]
assert removed==0,removed
assert unhidden==0,unhidden

without_back=copy.deepcopy(new)
without_back.remove(without_back.find(".//*[@id='shoe--shoe_back']"))
def render(r): return Image.open(io.BytesIO(render_svg(ET.tostring(r)))).convert('RGBA')
pixel_diff=ImageChops.difference(render(old),render(without_back)).convert('RGB')
visible_diff=pixel_diff.getbbox()
assert visible_diff is None,visible_diff

ids=[e.get('id') for e in new.iter() if e.get('id')]
assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))
part_groups=[e for e in new if e.get('data-part-path')]
assert len({e.get('data-part-path') for e in part_groups})==len(part_groups)
for e in part_groups:
 assert e.tag.endswith('}g') and e.get('id')
 for p in e:
  if p.tag.endswith('}path'):
   assert p.get('d').strip().upper().endswith('Z')
   assert p.get('stroke')=='none' and p.get('fill','').startswith('#')
assert [e.get('data-part-path') for e in new if e.get('data-part-path')]==['shoe/shoe_back','lower_leg/right_lower_leg','shoe/shoe_side','shoe/shoe_front']
hashes=json.loads((w/'input-hashes.json').read_text())
for p,h in hashes.items(): assert hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,p
assert json.loads((w/'bounds.draft.json').read_text())['status']=='pass'
result={
 'status':'pass',
 'viewport':[520,690],
 'unchanged_groups':unchanged,
 'shoe_front_geometry_unchanged':True,
 'input_tree_and_reference_unchanged':True,
 'unique_ids_and_bindings':True,
 'closed_solid_fills_without_strokes':True,
 'layer_order':['shoe_back','right_lower_leg','shoe_side','shoe_front'],
 'shoe_side_added_area_px2':added.histogram()[255]/16,
 'shoe_side_removed_area_px2':removed/16,
 'shoe_side_added_area_outside_front_occlusion_px2':unhidden/16,
 'existing_composition_diff_without_new_back_bbox':visible_diff,
 'bounds_check':'pass; all 3 direct parts have 0 outside samples',
 'viewed_evidence':['before-parts.png','before-opening.png','after-parts.png','after-opening.png','motion-leg-left.png','motion-leg-right.png','motion-front-seam.png'],
 'motion_diagnostics':{'leg_left':'translate(-10 0) rotate(-4 280 280)','leg_right':'translate(10 0) rotate(4 280 280)','front_shift':'translate(-8 0)','note':'仅为局部覆盖自检的临时 SVG；隐藏父底稿检查，交付 SVG 不含这些变换。'}
}
(w/'self-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
